title: 艾瑞森 arisun 风 R1 外胎寿命 1w 公里
notes: Owner post (2026-10-02): a 28 mm front and 30 mm rear STORM R1 (construction not stated) wore through to the casing at about 10,000 km, including the G318 Sichuan-Tibet road, for a 64 kg rider with a 230 W FTP; about five punctures. Commenters: one replaced theirs at 7,000 km after frequent punctures; others called 10,000 km durable.
